signIn.title: Sign in to austeris
signIn.wrong: That email and password do not match.
signIn.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.

form.incomplete: Some of the form is not filled in.
form.positiveAmounts: Amounts are written as positive numbers; whether money goes out or comes in is the kind of entry.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: What every account holds today, as its bank would say it.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.currencyHelp: A three-letter code: PYG, USD, RUB - or a coin's, such as BTC.
accounts.openingHelp: What was in it before austeris knew about it.
accounts.emptyBody: An account is where money sits: a wallet, a bank account, a card. Open the first one to start recording.
accounts.unconverted: Not counted - no rate known for {{currencies}}.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Every movement of money, newest first.
entries.emptyBody: Type a line above - 45000 food lunch - or open a full entry.

quick.label: Record an entry in one line
quick.help: Amount, category, words - then from account, @who, #tag, a currency code and @rate. A leading ~ marks it held.

entry.title: Entry
entry.counterpartyHelp: Who was paid, or who paid. A new name is created when the entry is saved.
entry.tagsHelp: One word each; press Enter after each.
entry.badTags: A tag is one word starting with a letter: {{tags}}
entry.held: Held - the bank has not posted it yet
entry.transferCurrencies: A transfer stays in one currency. Use Exchange to change money from one into another.
entry.actualAmountHelp: Only if the bank posted a different amount than was held:
entry.deleteBody: Its lines go with it, and the balances it moved move back. This cannot be undone.

exchange.title: Exchange money
exchange.sameCurrency: Both accounts are in the same currency. That is a transfer.
exchange.noReference: no day's rate to measure against
exchange.staleNoFee: the day's rate is too old to measure against

record.title: Record
record.description: What was just spent, in a line or with a press.
record.noButtons: No buttons yet. Open an entry below and make it a button: one press records it again.

template.name: On the button
template.askAmount: Ask for the amount each time
template.amountHelp: Left empty, the button asks each time.

entry.possible_duplicate: The same entry was recorded {{seconds}} s ago.

line.empty: There is nothing here to record.
line.no_amount: “{{word}}” is not an amount; a line starts with one, as in 45000 food lunch.
line.zero_amount: An entry of zero records nothing.
line.no_category: What was {{amount}} for? Add a category, as in {{amount}} food, or who was paid, as in {{amount}} @shop.
line.bad_rate: “{{word}}” is not a rate; write it as @5965.
line.bare_at: @ names nothing: @5965 is a rate, @shop is who was paid.
line.twice: “{{word}}” says again what the line already said; one rate and one counterparty to a line.
line.income_category: “{{category}}” is money coming in; write +{{amount}} for that.
line.expense_category: “{{category}}” is money going out; leave the + off for money spent.
line.no_open_account: There is no open account to record this against; open one first.
line.which_account: Which account? Choose one, or write from {{example}} - you have {{accounts}}.
line.no_usual_category: “{{counterparty}}” has no usual category; say what this was for, as in {{amount}} food @{{key}}.
line.unknown_counterparty: Nobody is called “{{name}}” yet; say what this was for, as in {{amount}} food @{{name}}, and it is created with that as its usual category.
line.unknown_category: You have no category called “{{name}}”; create it first.
line.ambiguous_category: “{{name}}” is more than one category ({{names}}); say which, as in living/{{name}}.
line.rate_without_currency: A rate converts an amount in another currency; this one is already in {{currency}}.
line.no_rate: No {{from}} to {{to}} rate is known on or before {{day}}; state the one you were charged, as in @5965.

template.name_taken: There is already a button by that name.
